# `bernoulli.trial()` {#fn-bernoulli-trial}

**Validation on 2.0.9005.** Exact and upper-tail probabilities agreed with independent binomial calculations for the tested counts up to 1,000, including zero hits. [S03 results](s03-scoring-checks.qmd).

[Function index](function-index.html#idx-bernoulli-trial)

```{=html}
<p>Define a hit and the per-structure chance of a hit before counting the orientations. A
single-count probability answers how often exactly that count arises; the upper tail
answers how often a count at least that large arises.
</p>
<p>The binomial model assumes independent structures with the same
target probability <code>p</code>. The upper-tail probability is a one-sided
p-value under this model. Calculations use <code>stats::dbinom</code> and
<code>stats::pbinom</code>, avoiding factorial overflow and subtraction from 1.
At least zero hits has probability 1. With zero structures, zero hits has
probability 1 for either type. Inputs are scalar; invalid inputs error.
</p>
```

<details><summary>Method references</summary>

```{=html}
<p>Ruggles, C (1999) <em>Astronomy in Prehistoric Britain and Ireland</em>. Yale University Press.
</p>



```

</details>

**Interpretation and limits.** The binomial formulation requires a defensible success probability and trial structure. Repeated structures at the same location may not act as independent trials. Delimit the target window before counting successes.


<details><summary>Implementation arguments, return value and documented modes</summary>

```{=html}
<table><thead><tr><th>Argument</th><th>Formal default</th><th>Behaviour in this interface</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row"><code>n</code></th><td>—</td><td><p>Total number of structures: a single finite nonnegative integer.</p></td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><code>p</code></th><td>—</td><td><p>Target probability: a single finite number between 0 and 1.</p></td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><code>r</code></th><td>—</td><td><p>Number of hits: a single finite integer between 0 and n.</p></td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><code>type</code></th><td><code>&quot;tail&quot;</code></td><td><p>Either <code>"single"</code> for exactly r hits or <code>"tail"</code>
for at least r hits (the default).</p></td></tr></tbody></table><h5>Return value</h5><p>A numeric probability between 0 and 1.
</p>
```

</details>
